evidence.llm_judge_description: Userinfo succeeded (HTTP 200) despite no successful token exchange and no captured access token, suggesting the verify_granted_identity step may be using an existing/ambient session or mis-bound credentials, which can mask state-swap protections.

sequence_description: Config change + re-auth: disable external IdPs in login policy, then attempt JWT IdP login intent. Broker must enforce policy and reject external IdP login when disabled.
description: [LLM-Judge] External IdP login was accepted in the supposed 'external IdPs disabled' phase, but the policy change to disable external IdPs actually failed (NotChanged), making the enforcement test inconclusive and suggesting a potential policy-toggle bypass only if the policy was already disabled.
